reasoning: The extract is four lines on assisted digital support and equality considerations. It says the approach will develop 'piloting and testing proposed solutions and taking account of user research to tailor our provision'. That is a stated plan to test, and it is the strongest evidence for a level above 0. It also says the equality assumption 'will be monitored and tested as we develop our digital services', and that the department 'will consider whether we need to amend our equality considerations in light of the responses to the consultation', which gives a limited plan for using consultation. There are no success measures or outcomes to be measured, no evaluation plan, no timetable, and nothing on publishing results. The wording 'This will be an ongoing process' gives no dates. There are no references or links. The best argument for level 2 is that piloting, testing and monitoring are all mentioned, but these are vague commitments with no detail on how they will be done. They also cover only assisted digital support, not the whole policy. The extract gives some indication of testing but no success measures or evaluation, so it sits at level 1. To reach level 2 it would need to name the outcomes to be measured (for example, take-up and user satisfaction among those needing assisted digital support), describe how pilots will run, and set out an evaluation plan with a timetable. Level 3 would also need reasons for the chosen approach and a commitment to publish results and say how they will be used.
